verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents dedicated 'Blob Storage Export' for scheduled bulk export of large volumes, plus Metrics API v2 and SDK-based querying for programmatic data access, directly matching the export-to-warehouse/blob-storage use case. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the export feature's scale/reliability and explicit data-warehouse (e.g. Snowflake/BigQuery) connector documentation beyond blob storage.
